raw: 23.1 CI Against Terrorist and Criminal Intelligence Networks[^12]
teaching_note: Define the particular harmful conduct and lawful protective purpose, not a suspect population. Descriptive labels for organizations do not establish culpability of members, neighbors, employees or associates; protected activity and lawful association remain outside adverse inference. The overview is not legal authority or case-level evidence [@ageint012].
title: CI Against Terrorist and Criminal Intelligence Networks

raw: 23.2 The Counterintelligence Threat from Non-State Actors[^33]
teaching_note: Non-state actors vary in organization, resources and aims; neither state sponsorship nor sophistication follows from the category. The cited paper is a topical lead, but its incomplete local description cannot warrant specific capability claims without inspected passages. Separate organizational claims, observed artifact behavior and individual responsibility [@ageint033].
title: The Counterintelligence Threat from Non-State Actors

teaching_note: A hybrid framing can combine different means without establishing one operator, sponsor or legal threshold. Make separate claims for observed interference, possible coordination and evidence of direction/control, retaining independent error and ordinary commercial activity as alternatives. A professional argument about strategic competition does not authorize additional collection [@ageint109].
title: CI in Hybrid Threat Environments

raw: 23.4 Attribution Problems in Non-State CI Operations[^33]
teaching_note: Completed offline case: F1 is a synthetic shared-file log showing a vendor-role download; F2 is a contract appendix allowing that file; F3 is an incomplete export log; there is no external disclosure record. Filled claims: download observed (F1), access appears authorized (F2), theft and state sponsorship unsupported (no relevant evidence); a reporting gap is the weakest link, not proof of concealment. Withheld F4 identifies F3's missing interval as a scheduled export pause, so remove that suspicious feature and close the theft allegation; authorized custodians may handle ordinary log quality without creating dossiers or expanding collection. The analysis-only result holds attribution and protects the report from unjustified person-level conclusions (see [@sec:analytic-workflow]).
title: Attribution Problems in Non-State CI Operations

raw: 23.5 Corporate Counterintelligence and Trade Secret Protection
teaching_note: Separate information classification, legal trade-secret status, authorized access, actual disclosure and intent: none follows automatically from a download. Trade-secret status and remedies require jurisdiction-specific legal evidence, which these technical assurance references do not supply. Teach minimized protected reporting and authorized access review, not employee surveillance, competitive intelligence collection or legal conclusions.
title: Corporate Counterintelligence and Trade Secret Protection
